topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: Well, ain't that just the way things go. Old Tom up the hill, he found a room hidden away in his new house. A secret, it was, nestled behind the walls. Some folks are whispering 'bout treasures and secrets, but poor me, I can't get to thinking much on such things. The rain's been scarce, and the debt collectin' grows heavier than the last. The saints, they watch over us, but sometimes the clouds they hide, and the sky, it doesn’t seem to care. Maybe Tom’s found himself a bit of luck, but here, my fields grow thin, and the soil, it whispers of harder times.
